name: vscode-agent-bridge
displayName: Agent Bridge: Browser & Terminal for Claude Code
description: Gives Claude Code (and other MCP agents) first-class access to VS Code's integrated browser tabs and integrated terminals, per window and per agent session.

commands.title: Done: Hand Terminal Back to Agent
Won't Do: Decline Agent's Terminal Request

agentBridge.sessionGraceSeconds.description: How long a disconnected agent session keeps its tabs and terminals before they are released. Lets an agent reconnect after a window reload.

enumDescriptions: Ask before an agent session reads or types in a terminal you opened (once per terminal and session).
Agent sessions may read and type in your terminals without asking.
Agent sessions never get access to your terminals (they still see that they exist).
agentBridge.terminal.userTerminals.description: Whether agent sessions may read and type in terminals you opened yourself.

enumDescriptions: Keep the session's terminals open, so you can still read them; whatever runs in them keeps running.
Close the session's terminals that are at an idle prompt; keep those still running something (e.g. a dev server).
Close all of the session's terminals, stopping whatever runs in them.
agentBridge.terminal.onSessionEnd.description: What happens to an agent session's terminals when the session ends (after the reconnect grace period).

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
